query: WITH entities AS (SELECT workflow_id, created_at, id FROM agents WHERE (workflow_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $1) AND ((created_at, id) > ($4, $3)) AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT $2) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $5 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN agent_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.created_at asc, i.id asc, i.id, e.sequence
